verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents a public API that covers contacts (bulk update, upsert), list fields, campaign click reports and starting automations for a contact. That is real programmatic access to core data. The UI, however, also offers a drag-and-drop email editor, templates, landing pages, forms, multi-user management and send scheduling, and the API docs in the pack show no equivalent endpoints for these, so full UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: API evidence for creating, editing and sending or scheduling campaigns, managing templates, forms, landing pages and users, and any parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
